programme.title: 蝴蝶公墓普
programme.desc: 舞蹈家尚小蝶,為五年前離開的戀人編排了一支蝶舞,大獲成功,受國外文化基金邀請去布達佩斯選角編舞小蝶在所有舞者中最看好自卑的白露,白露告訴小蝶,想要藉助蝴蝶公墓找到失蹤的姐姐小蝶還發現,基金繼承人莊秋水就是自己五年前的戀人但隨着舞者宋優中毒,田巧墜樓,白露失蹤,小蝶自己也受到威脅一切謎團都指向了蝴蝶公墓

programme.title: 神槍手與咖喱雞粵普
programme.desc: 岑健昌與江理基是香港皇家警察中的兩名幹探,兩人因為身手了得,手法火爆,屢破奇案身手所以在警界,有棘手雙雄之稱故事的發生是因為有一幫會的龍頭大哥被人暗殺,警方估計將會有可能引起連串的江湖大火拼,所以派出在警界有槍王之稱的槍王英主持調查該案,而岑健昌與江理基則負責協助槍王英調查起初兩人不服槍王英的辦事方法,處處發生衝突,直至槍王英向兩人表現出其精湛的槍法及其對槍械的豐富知識,兩人才開始對槍王

programme.title: 狂蟒之災普
programme.desc: 連年虧損的民間馬戲團被團長連人帶物賤賣給奸商,新老闆「大金牙」以高額回報為誘餌,哄騙宮蘭蘭,阿麗等團員一同前往泰國進行巡演途中,眾人在東南亞熱帶雨林水域遭遇神秘巨蟒襲擊,並救下了一名自稱謝夫的神秘男子nn隨後接連不斷的蟒蛇攻擊導致船隻沉沒,謝夫提出帶領眾人穿越雨林尋找自己的船隻然而,隨着危險不斷升級,馬戲團成員逐漸發現謝夫的真實身份竟是殘忍的偷獵者眾人在危機四伏的熱帶雨林中被迫與巨蟒

programme.title: 桃姐粵普
programme.desc: 本片改編自真人真事,講述生長於大家庭梁家的少爺Roger與自幼照顧自己長大的家傭媽鍾春桃之間所發生的一段溫暖人心的主僕情故事:桃姐13歲就到梁家當媽姐,轉眼60年過去,她已伺候了梁家老少四代人梁家人有的去世,有的移民了,近十年間只剩下桃姐和梁家少爺Roger在一起生活,主僕兩人相處頗有默契但很少交流後來有一天,桃姐突然中風,Roger把她送去安養院,由此展開了一段觸動人心的主僕情

programme.title: 秋天的童話粵
programme.desc: 美麗而驕縱的年輕姑娘十三妹(Jenny)(鍾楚紅 飾)隻身從香港赴紐約攻讀大學,並探望先她赴美的男友Vincent(陳百強 飾)前來機場接她的,是一個在唐人街打工的遠房親戚船頭尺(周潤發 飾)(「船頭尺」是雙關語,意思是「度水」,在香港俗語中為借錢的意思)滿口髒話,粗俗不堪的船頭尺被人看作「爛鬼」船頭尺初時對十三妹感到厭煩,並稱她為「茶煲」(即英文的trouble,麻煩的意思)nn十

programme.title: 花花型警粵普
programme.desc: 警察麥克是個愛出風頭的富家子,常常花老爸的錢辦案,雖然破案無數,卻無法贏得警局同事以及女朋友麗莎的認同,還被大家厭煩地稱作花花型警,在發覺麗莎與來自大陸的警察林亨關係密切後,麥克心升醋意

programme.title: 高度戒備粵普
programme.desc: O記重案組督察包Sir 因一宗謀殺案拘捕了悍匪麥坤,但發現案中有案,麥坤正準備與台灣黨羽紳士密謀一宗驚天大劫案

programme.title: 千王之王2000粵普
programme.desc: 老千法拉利在香港以上流社會身份周旋富豪當中重案組探員寬,以臥底身份混入法家參與豪門宴,發現其家人全是肥人,當進行拘捕行動時,全屋佈置已改,法家全是瘦人寬混入監獄拜姐夫黃師虎求教本領,黃幫他對付法,虎扮成馬來西亞富商出現法家

programme.title: 喋血雙雄粵
programme.desc: 阿莊(周潤發 飾)是一個職業殺手,因為在「工作」時被發現而遭僱主解僱,然而開槍時的火光意外令年輕夜總會歌手珍妮失明(葉蒨文 飾)為了幫助珍妮,阿莊籌了一大筆錢來替她做恢復視力的眼角膜移植阿莊惹來一個警探李鷹(李修賢 飾)調查他的犯罪,最終兩人因緣際會地遇上因為見到阿莊先前救過一名小女孩,再得知珍妮的手術後,李鷹明白到,逮捕這個殺手並不能達到正義電影的高潮,是兩人與三合會在廢棄的教堂內

programme.title: 黑金粵
programme.desc: 法務部調查局幹員兼機動小組組長方國輝(劉德華飾)為人嫉惡如仇,幹練打擊社會不法活動,第一目標是當時危害社會的賭博電玩,調查結果發現此案背後的幕後藏鏡人是黑幫老大周朝先(梁家輝飾);周朝先的事業不斷被公家掃蕩,於是在記者會上公開聲明要參選立法委員,設法由黑道轉換到台灣政治舞台,想藉由民意代表的保護傘拯救自己,並從此當中得到政治保護,周朝先不惜賄賂政府官員及政黨權貴,甚至以挲圓仔湯的方式進行圍標

programme.title: 驚天救援普
programme.desc: 一場突如其來的地震波及整個灌城化工園區,管道泄漏觸發爆炸不斷濃煙滾滾,火光沖天,災難迅速升級,如果任其蔓延,整座城市將被夷為平地面對要救火又要救人的嚴峻考驗,消防救援站一眾隊員第一時間奔赴重災區,危難時刻爭分奪秒,用生命守護生命

programme.title: 喜愛夜蒲3粵普

programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.title: 見怪
programme.desc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!

programme.title: 罪慾 - 地獄門
programme.desc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am

programme.title: 凌晨三點鐘 - 醫院
programme.desc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈? 在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷

programme.title: 凌晨兩點半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密

programme.title: 天之書
programme.desc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……

programme.title: Guns of Eden
programme.desc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民

programme.title: 錯愛迷蹤
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

programme.title: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
programme.desc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮

programme.title: Mulu Nakru (The Masters Face)
programme.desc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於

programme.title: 凌晨三點鐘 - 公司
programme.desc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。

programme.title: 罪慾 - 女朋友
programme.desc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。

programme.title: The Ones You Didnt Burn
programme.desc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今

programme.desc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今

programme.title: 罪慾 - 人體模特
programme.desc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。

programme.title: 怪談
programme.desc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為瞭解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最

programme.title: Malee
programme.desc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密

programme.title: Red Snow
programme.desc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,

programme.title: 方世玉與洪熙官
programme.desc: 清兵火燒少林寺後,少林弟子洪熙官身受重傷,負傷逃亡。途經此地的方世玉誤以為洪熙官是窮凶極惡之徒,遂將他交給清兵。當方世玉得知自己錯捉洪熙官後,便千方百計設法營救,好讓二人聯手對抗清兵。

programme.title: 御貓三戲錦毛鼠
programme.desc: 展昭、白玉堂武功不相上下。白一次無意中救了皇帝獲嘉封,卻不相信其身份,揚長而去。後皇帝再遇險,被展所救,展即獲御封。白不忿設計盜去玉璽,欲戲弄展,幸展武功高強,終不辱皇命而回。

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。

programme.title: 楚留香
programme.desc: 某天,俠盜楚留香歡宴好友無花和尚,神水宮的宮南燕突然來到,指稱楚盜去神水宮的天一神水,且用以毒殺多人。在楚留香極力否認下,宮南燕表示他需於一個月內找出真凶,否則必將置其於死地。楚留香為證明自身清白,決意著手調查此事件

programme.title: 蝴蝶盃
programme.desc: 明朝時代,書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義,誤殺總督之子,被迫逃亡。走投無路時,他逃至江畔,幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物,締結終身之約。

programme.title: 黑鷹
programme.desc: 新加坡的黑鷹組織專與香港保險業作對。私家偵探張世傑從黑鷹領袖陳祖培女兒麗思入手。他倆認識後,不斷受到狙擊追殺,原來陳祖培於一年前已遭人殺害,胡媚用陳名義發號施令,為非作歹。張世傑與黑鷹集團展開連場激戰!

programme.title: 後門
programme.desc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編,故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年,膝下猶虛,對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚,孤苦伶仃,徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女,琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現,要接回阿琳;徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉,毅然將阿琳交回親母。

programme.title: 小英雄
programme.desc: 主角小雜種由隱士撫養並授以武術;一天,隱士囑他下山訪尋父母。途中,他體驗到人情冷暖,先與女乞丐小乙惺惺相惜,建立「同是天涯淪落人」的友 誼,亦與邑紳之子顧英豪結怨。最後,他終於從妓院鴇母口中得知自己的身世,原來其生母本在顧家為婢,被老爺引誘成姦後,又遭虐待致死…

programme.title: 武松
programme.desc: 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕。後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇。

programme.title: 遊俠情
programme.desc: 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖,途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒,杜挺身相救,沐萬分感激。未幾,杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男。及後,杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨,黑道首領是李之殺父仇人,而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒…

programme.title: 椰林春戀
programme.desc: 富商之子平建人由於不願繼承父業,決定跟女朋友蘇詠蘭自開旅行社,招攬女教師董嫻芸和四個少女學生遊覽馬來西亞。詠蘭在旅途中眼看女學生李愛蓉癡戀建人,又誤會建人與嫻芸相戀,傷心失望離去。後來發現嫻芸早有情人梁茂夫,一場誤會始告冰釋。愛蓉得悉建人將與詠蘭結婚,精神失常,駕車撞山受傷昏迷……

programme.title: 少林寺
programme.desc: 當時前往少林寺習武者眾多,清廷已命令民間不得練武,一直尋找機會將之除掉。少林弟子決定從木人巷闖出寺去抗爭,以少林絕學了卻了自己的仇恨,但發現清兵已對少林寺展開偷襲行動,於是決意不惜一切要保護少林寺。

programme.title: 風花雪月
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路

programme.title: 宋宮秘史
programme.desc: 包公發現劉妃在二十年前為保其位而謀害李妃,將李妃剛誕下的兒子調走後,把她逐出皇宮。於是,包公用妙計誘大太監郭槐認罪,揭發當年他與劉妃合謀陷害李妃之奸計,並將劉妃定罪。而李妃也被接回皇宮,與已為皇帝的兒子團聚。

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會

programme.title: 圓月彎刀
programme.desc: 青年俠士丁鵬連番擊敗多名武功高手,但却在一次與武術名家決戰中慘敗。他萬念俱灰中擬自戕,卻竟與魔教教主孫女青青邂逅。兩人不久更到談婚論嫁,教主特將一柄「圓月彎刀」贈予丁鵬,惟要他答應此生不離開魔教地界與青青白頭到老…

programme.title: 釣金龜
programme.desc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去台北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……

programme.title: 八萬罪人
programme.desc: 香港在1953至1955年,曾被警方稱為最黑暗的時期,那時候罪惡泛濫,百弊叢生,一日可發生三十二宗驚人案件,而犯罪份子有百分之四十是積犯;英廷特派專員來港調查監獄的措施,發現獄中不良份子,濫用權力,公報私仇,歪曲政府的監獄制度,造成犯人越變越黑,監獄變成地獄。影片主角江才因不甘受探長侮辱,結果被控妨

programme.title: 八國聯軍
programme.desc: 清朝末年政局腐敗,社會民不聊生,慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔,以及保護人民的能力,反而迷信以吞符唸咒,自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人,決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京,慈禧太后倉惶逃難;人民這才醒悟到,只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動,才是挽救中國的唯一希望。

programme.title: 斷魂谷
programme.desc: 斷魂谷趙家莊主趙雲陽有兩弟子,趙玉龍和趙劍英。玉龍終年浪蕩江湖,却得雲陽所有財産。劍英不憤,害死師父嫁禍玉龍,幷引其子金虎追殺玉龍。兩人在斷魂穀决鬥,劍英欲收漁人之利,幸金虎和玉龍發現穀中有埋伏,詐傷引出主谋,連手反攻

programme.title: 星際鈍胎
programme.desc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟,事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是,當她打算一死以示清白之際,卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意,卻遭遇一連串奇遇,而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。

programme.title: 神刀
programme.desc: 神刀大俠臨終時,把神刀傳給了徒弟林振嘯,而且更識破了另一徒弟方世雄為奪神刀而混入門下的奸計。方世雄為了神刀,令林家破人亡和雙目失明。最後,林振嘯與方世雄大戰為家人報仇,並誓要重奪神刀…

programme.title: 梁山伯與祝英台
programme.desc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學,並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後,立即前往祝家提親,豈料英台早已被許配他人,二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度,一病不起,最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗,悲痛欲絕,哭祭山伯墳前,更縱身躍入墓中,以身殉情。

programme.title: 大海盜
programme.desc: 海盜張保仔洗劫一艘外國商船後,發現海盜船身出現裂痕。於是他上岸尋找材料修船,竟發現清朝貪官正在欺壓貧苦農民。本性善良的張保仔,決心要鋤強扶弱,最終更成為著名的大海盜。

programme.title: 雙鳳奇緣
programme.desc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主

programme.title: 賭王大騙局
programme.desc: 沙氏家族的賭術、千術已達出神入化的境界,在賭壇更是無人不知,無人不曉,而沙通更是青出于藍而勝于藍,在賭壇素有“賭王”之譽,甚少遇到對手。然而,沙通亦背負一段由賭而來的深仇,其師遭牌霸彭天石誣告販毒,被判刑十多年。沙通矢志為師報仇,欲以“老千千老千, 騙子騙騙子”的手段對付彭天石…

programme.title: 西遊記
programme.desc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。

programme.title: 西遊記
programme.desc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。

programme.title: 日劫
programme.desc: 由老木匠收養的石生,長大後發現自己擁有異於常人的超能力,原來他乃是太陽神之子,但每逢日蝕的時候,石生便會失去超能力。一天,惡魔出現並大肆殺戮和破壞,石生誓與惡魔決一死戰以拯救世界。

programme.title: 武則天
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。

programme.title: 豪客
programme.desc: 陸虎出獄後,發現自己原來是被陰險的弟弟陸彪所陷害,更奪去家族煤礦生意。妹妹欲阻止陸彪,反被他監禁起來。陸虎救出妹妹後,發現煤礦已被日本幫派所奪,他們誓要打敗日本人取回煤礦。

programme.title: 寒煙翠
programme.desc: 陳詠薇的父母準備離異,於是把她送到章家暫住。章家長子凌霄、次子凌風、三女凌雲和年輕畫家余亞南都對詠薇很好,使她在章家農場度過了難忘的暑假。

programme.title: 殘缺
programme.desc: 莊主杜天道其子被人斬去雙臂,性格變得暴戾。無故地先後打傷四人致殘。四人成殘缺一族,走投無路,入深山找師父授以武功,立志報仇…

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神
programme.desc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。

programme.title: 絕不低頭

programme.desc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #5
programme.desc: 狗隻在本集利用其出色的嗅覺進行拯救生命和積極地保護環境治安的工作在加拿大,一隊偵緝犬正在嗅探破壞性的入侵物種斑馬貽貝,這些貽貝對北美的湖泊和河流造成嚴重破壞

programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #6
programme.desc: 加拿大的夏季短捉,時間緊迫- 任何時候都是戰鬥的好時機宏大的北方為野牛,禿鷹和北極熊提供了動物王國中激戰的戰場

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #1
programme.desc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #2
programme.desc: 如同亞馬遜的森林一樣豐富,尋找愛情和養家一樣是個挑戰,交配策略也跟動物一樣各適其適

programme.title: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
programme.desc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛

programme.title: 野火劫後 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #3
programme.desc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #3
programme.desc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由

programme.title: 猩猩成長記 #1
programme.desc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中,高中和野外實習學校與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備

programme.title: 猩猩成長記 #2
programme.desc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺,尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #4
programme.desc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方

programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛

programme.title: 野火劫後 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #5
programme.desc: 處理爭鬥的小鴨圍捕,看看獸醫卡琳娜 (Karina) 是否會請專家來治療考拉斯派克 (Spike) 的腿部骨折深入了解困擾針鼴寶寶乒 (Ping) 和乓 (Pong) 的胃病問題,並遇到了似乎迷路了的考拉賈拉 (Jarrah)

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存

programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺

programme.title: 最後衝擊

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦

programme.title: 女神們 #3
programme.desc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片

programme.title: 女神們 #4
programme.desc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈

programme.title: 女神們 #5
programme.desc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一

programme.title: 布魯斯威利:全美英雄
programme.desc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折

programme.title: 雪兒:她的故事
programme.desc: 走進 Cher 的世界--這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化

programme.title: 布萊德彼特:突破好萊塢
programme.desc: 他可能是最性感的好萊塢演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道布萊德彼特整個好萊塢首屈一指的人物之一一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事

programme.title: 阿諾史瓦辛格:為行動而生
programme.desc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗

programme.title: 湯姆漢克斯:演無不克
programme.desc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽而我們都知道他是 湯姆漢克斯

programme.title: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
programme.desc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了

programme.title: 最後衝擊

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #1
programme.desc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #2
programme.desc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch

programme.title: Aunty Moves in
programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Serial Swindlers
programme.desc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: For years, allegations of war crimes have swirled around Australia’s special forces in Afghanistan Australian prosecutors have been investigating a small group of elite special forces who stand accused of committing and covering up the murder of civilians in Afghanistan With exclusive footage and testimony from a former special forces operative, this documentary reveals a shocking culture of murder and impunity

programme.title: Peace On The Tigris
programme.desc: The Tigris River, which was the site of the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, still flows majestically through Baghdad, Iraq's capital In March2003, the area around this river underwent intense airstrikes by US and British forces The US armed forces gained control of Baghdad Journalist Watai Takeharu witnessed the moment when the bronze statue of then-president Saddam Hussein was pulled down The next day he saw many victims of the airstrikes at a city hospital There he met 31-year-old Ali Saqban, whose home had been destroyed in the bombing In his arms he was carrying his 5-year-old daughter Shahad, whose body was covered with blood

programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 如果還有明天

方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#166粵
programme.desc: 慶被友人的頑皮小孩作弄。當慶與小孩父母爭論時，卻被指他的子女亦不算好。慶回家指眾人沒有公德心後奪門而出，卻發現被他視作契仔的養龜「有龜」及其伴侶竟「離家出走」。連番打擊下，慶認為他的下一代已沒有希望。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#11粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康因養育之恩放完顏洪烈離開，黃蓉與郭靖趕到時已不見其蹤影，卻意外發現被關在棺材裡的穆念慈。楊康無意中聽到黃蓉說自己放不下小王爺的身分，便帶著穆念慈不辭而別。郭靖到客棧找拖雷時，受託照顧患病的華箏。

食平3D粵
programme.desc: 香港人食無定時，熱氣、食慾不振自然在所難免。肥媽出動苦瓜湯，打救六號響起警鐘的身體。「薯仔免治牛肉」想將薯仔、牛肉煮到粒粒分明，秘訣何在？「白焯魚柳」、「合掌瓜白胡椒燜雞」同樣毋需花巧的廚藝。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 整容高風險？整形外科醫生解答疑惑。在香港，最常見的整容手術包括雙眼皮、抽脂、隆胸，醫生逐一細說詳情，以及連帶的風險與併發症。而揀選專業的醫生施手術，極為重要！左心室將含氧血液泵往各器官，如力量不足，會有重大影響！醫治相關狀況有「四大支柱」藥物，各有甚麼效用？心臟科醫生提到，臨床還有機會要增加新藥物，從而減低病人心臟衰竭，甚至死亡的風險。「睇餸食飯」環節，許美德師傅烹調一道時令美食「薄殼米炒飯」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 秀怡駕駛，接載凱晴、超怡「港車北上」，並約同慧儀入住珠海的五星級酒店，望着港珠澳大橋於泳池嬉水，價格還包括早、晚自助餐！溫體牛由屠宰到上桌時間迅速，讓顧客食出肉材鮮味，價錢一定離地？跟主持往深圳火鍋店吃，鮮嫩得來花費亦化算。吃完再到超市搜購肉食，切記生肉不許帶過境。港島某雞蛋仔店製作用心，更推出加一蚊多一底優惠？另有精品朱古力飲買一送一着數。眾人還到網紅餐廳一試人均近千元的四人餐，最終三三折埋單？

programme.title: 東坡家事#27粵PG
programme.desc: 季常獲閏之告知月娥患病，季常找月娥祈求照顧她被拒絕。淑眉被發現沉屍水井，閏之被帶返衙門。東坡等重演案件，卻無線索。獄吏指皇上下旨納妃後處決閏之；月娥到蘇家追問，東坡指未找出兇手，但肯定犯人只有一人。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 春天和暖令小丸子老是賴床，小丸子打聽有何方法令自己順利起床，並發現花輪教的播音樂方法十分有效。小丸子重新開始集郵，獲高丸太太贈送一袋外國郵票，誰知卻在裡面發現一張印刷歪斜的版票。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 錄影廠內擺放着兩件「蛋糕」，原來是由「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓以韓式唧花技術所製的蛋糕造型擺設，箇中技巧與製作翻糖公仔款蛋糕，有何分別？嘉賓亦即席以韓式唧花技術，快速完成一朵玫瑰。對於初學者，可先用忌廉嘗試，但原來這門手藝經過十幾年發展，豆蓉、朱古力、輕黏土、棉花糖都可以放入唧袋內做出不同作品。不過，每種「材料」的質地不一，部份未必能做出細緻花型。嘉賓也憶述學藝與教學點滴，並談及最喜愛的作品。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 沙律公主偷走出城堡外，西洋菜爺爺急忙尋找。苦瓜人遇上正在著急的西洋菜爺爺，於是自動請纓幫忙尋找沙律公主。細菌人偷聽到果Jam叔叔將會前往沙漠小鎮派麵包，於是企圖搶奪果Jam叔叔的麵包。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 樓盤新視野 之港島東太古式生活粵
programme.desc: 啟德再有新居屋入伙，浴室、廚房均採用立體預製部件，交樓質素如何？漏水問題有沒改善？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 連鎖快餐店內，男子疑因不滿食物質素向職員投訴，其後更大肆搗亂……安達臣道某屋苑的居民控訴，屋苑停車場違泊嚴重，更有車輛阻塞消防通道。事主曾向管理公司反映，惟情況未見改善。跟進報道「垃圾三文魚」食安危機，外景主持現身追問「三文魚姊妹花」。有人否認轉售過期三文魚，並承諾不會再撿拾，另一婦人則轉身逃跑。攝製隊亦向有關食品工場了解，對方指稱曾以漂白水處理棄置食品，提醒市民切勿食用。另帶來生活用品購物情報。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#8粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄承繼父親的物業，每月收取豐厚租金，還改建名下一物業單位，與友人合辦共享空間「開心小棧」，理應經濟充裕。嘉冰着嘉驄出資打造金器送贈親戚，嘉驄卻諸多推搪。嘉冰向唐芯問及「開心小棧」的經營狀況，察覺不妥，遂暗中監察嘉驄，竟有重大發現，懷疑他花天酒地、為女人大灑金錢，於是與唐芯設法「拯救」嘉驄，卻揭開不為人知的真相。嘉冰欲為嘉驄出頭追討損失，卻不果，幸而萬里、唐芯動員人脈，合力為嘉驄解困……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#13粵PG
programme.desc: 啟榮欲剔除家謙的計劃失敗。幸如因熙妍醉言醉語，得悉家謙結婚在即；家謙獨自借酒消愁。苓君高調公開家謙、曉彤婚訊，二人在人前表面恩愛，家謙在人後亦向曉彤表示會為二人關係努力。隨着婚訊公開，家謙、熙妍的身分亦曝光……繼威為協助其昌的私幫生意賺快錢，不惜利用雪文。雪文繼續主動討好佩貞，又登堂入室宣示主權……幸如好意協助運送繼威一組遺下的道具到拍攝現場，到達後卻見氣氛有異，懷疑繼威打算在此向她求婚。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#18粵普
programme.desc: 寄舟替蜜語解圍，之後蜜語喝醉，寄舟抱她到自己房間，被酒店其他人看到，引發軒然大波，集體投訴舉報她影響公司聲譽，最後紀封和寄舟把事件給解決；浦菜中菜廳選用中式下午茶為招?，找來蜜語媽媽製作蘇式船點

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 遊走智利聖地牙哥，芷珮先往百年市集歎帝王蟹，再試試老字號餡餅滋味。復活節島是一座神秘火山島，以摩艾石像聞名。芷珮踏足「工場」遺址，探秘昔日原住民如何利用火山岩製作石像，還可看到逾三百個完成度不一的石像，好壯觀！島上各處隱藏着大大小小的石像，一於踏單車環島遊覽摩艾文化與自然風光。捕捉日落美景後，走進歌舞餐廳跟原住民共舞。想帶走石像做手信，都有雕刻與倒模款式之分？融入天然水果的石像型肥皂，也值得入手。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.desc: 定垚答應投資程凱公司，承諾不會催促進度，程凱喜上眉梢。啟堂懷疑大嶼山項目的環評報告有蹊蹺，找人調查，天生早一步解決，啟堂氣結。程凱遲遲未能遞交智能家居進度，定垚設計刺激程凱，讓他乖乖趕工。澤雨認識了來自香港的甘日朗與謝安東，二人計劃建立烹飪平台，澤雨決定投資，想不到合作的網紅竟然是端兒。在活動上，兆齊口不擇言，戲說天生與明晞無子送終。明晞回家後哭崩，問天生信不信報應？

programme.title: 東坡家事#28粵PG
programme.desc: 月娥承認殺死淑眉；少游發現疑點後告知東坡，東坡憶起可疑人物。史密到湖邊交畫給子才，東坡現身卻遭打暈。東坡與史密被關在密室，史密認錯道出真相……東坡和少游在御前揭穿琴操身分；琴操欲殺皇上，東坡挺身阻止。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#166粵
programme.desc: 慶被友人的頑皮小孩作弄。當慶與小孩父母爭論時，卻被指他的子女亦不算好。慶回家指眾人沒有公德心後奪門而出，卻發現被他視作契仔的養龜「有龜」及其伴侶竟「離家出走」。連番打擊下，慶認為他的下一代已沒有希望。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#11粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康因養育之恩放完顏洪烈離開，黃蓉與郭靖趕到時已不見其蹤影，卻意外發現被關在棺材裡的穆念慈。楊康無意中聽到黃蓉說自己放不下小王爺的身分，便帶著穆念慈不辭而別。郭靖到客棧找拖雷時，受託照顧患病的華箏。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 陳松伶(松松)人靚聲甜，男女老少「通殺」，久別TVB的她回「娘家」登台，話盡當年，獻唱經典靚歌。松松與秋官、阿姐合唱歌曲，並與巨聲幫譚嘉儀、林師傑、周志康及「Think Big大明星」一起演繹兒歌。

programme.desc: 根發起男士暢飲聚會，但他發現人數愈來愈少。麗在代替喜分發花紅，但根卻發現自己的那份被麗以各種理由扣去，根怒極欲報仇，卻被亨發現。當晚，眾人更迫根負起責任，要他交伙食費及家用，根為此離家出走。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#12粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康和穆念慈為了賺取回家盤纏，在街頭賣藝，官差故意為難，楊康氣怒之下打傷他們；郭靖到桃花島找黃蓉時遇上周伯通，周伯通想讓郭靖陪他拆招解悶；眼見郭靖執意尋找黃蓉，周伯通建議郭靖找師父洪七公來給自己撐腰。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血脂泛指膽固醇與三酸甘油酯，一旦出現異常，便可能誘發多種心臟疾病。內分泌及糖尿科醫生介紹新的血脂異常管理指引，並帶來改善建議。完成「通波仔」手術人士或擔心運動會加重心臟負擔，註冊物理治療師建議病友應循序漸進，讓心肺功能慢慢適應復康運動。治療師細說做運動時的安全指引與三不原則，若出現甚麼情況應立即停止？此外，嘉賓還即場引領主持做復康鍛練。「睇餸食飯」環節，廚藝專家傅季馨帶來「吉列魚柳伴他他汁」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 珠海某大學區隱藏滋味手工菜，筲箕海鮮配陳村粉、苦瓜撈起別具特色，「江南百花雞」更是經典名菜。凱晴、慧儀及後體驗騎馬樂，除了學騎術，不少得餵飼馬匹培養感情。深圳的大學區也有美食，吃過爆膏大頭蝦、鮮甜生蠔等火鍋料，再歎粥底精華。超市海鮮拼盤六十元人仔有找，還要無伏？香港都有性價比高的日式廚師發辦，十八道菜食材皆來自日本，人均僅約四百元！接着「味」遊泰國，品嚐由「摘星」名廚秘製食譜的招牌魷魚、船麵火鍋。

programme.desc: 城崎生日將至，笹山計劃偷偷為她辦生日會，小丸子為送什麼生日禮物給城崎而煩惱。藤木原來只比城崎遲一天生日，小丸子因為說過希望天天都能參加朋友的生日會，無奈之下唯有替藤木慶祝生日。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，Mandy姐姐繼續帶領大家感受運動的快樂。她教大家利用紙張作道具，進行全身訓練。除了融入踢毽子的動作，還建議小朋友可把紙換成抹布，運動之餘還能幫媽媽做家務，一舉兩得！接着，Mandy姐姐引領大家進行下肢肌力訓練，做出深蹲、抬腿等動作。完成後，她不忘提醒各位要補充水分，此舉亦可有效促進肌肉修復、恢復體力。另外，本集也會播放AI生成動畫《北風和太陽》的下半部份。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 自小夢想成為戰鬥女英雄的如月牡丹，對三位公主心生仰慕，更因此自行縫製一套公主服，讓自己扮演洋紅公主。正當牡丹摸索如何成為一個公主時，突然遇到上好奇心旺盛的小女孩，迫水淺葱。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#9粵
programme.desc: 萬里的組員何文謙、曾碧池與巫慧慧為表忠心而杯葛楊帆，惹起不少事端，文謙更不慎打破價值不菲的展品。萬里前往排舞室找物主張太道歉，發現張太與公關界聲譽不佳的型男范特栖練舞，表現親暱。楊帆亦到來，自稱為相同目的而來，萬里覺得奇怪，藉詞阻攔讓張太離去。然而，楊帆終究搶先擺平此事。另一方面，萬里、楊帆同時聘請秘書，碧池等人報復楊帆，為他物色一位「極品」秘書莫希靈。希靈以為終於有人賞識自己，卻意外發現真相……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#14粵PG
programme.desc: 繼威早已拜託佩貞騙走雪文，免被雪文壞事。熙妍受浩恩所託幫他追求幸如，意外洞悉繼威的求婚大計。雪文察覺被騙，震怒趕至拍攝現場，揚言要公開繼威與自己出軌之事……繼威向幸如求婚，她無懼群眾壓力，斷言拒絕，更向繼威、雪文作出反擊……雪文知道繼威仍打算跟幸如結婚，惱恨吃醋。美淇最終沒有辭職。幸如、家謙推測繼威、其昌收受回佣，但苦無實證。幸如故意激怒雪文，要藉此令她供出繼威，雪文卻忿然道出憎恨幸如的原因。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#19粵普
programme.desc: 紀封向蜜語道歉卻不被接受。蜜語母加入酒店擔任船點顧問改良下午茶。予誠收到關於婚內財產糾紛的傳票被貞貞發現了。予誠答應貞貞在浦榮裡辦公司團隊建立；予誠跟蜜語到一旁談判，讓貞貞和蜜語母看到，眾人發生衝突…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 兌換了美金，芷珮就開展厄瓜多爾的自駕遊旅程，向亞馬遜森林的範圍出發。途中瞥見餐廳即下車一試，凍蝦配熱飯吃，頗怪卻好味！芷珮此行已申請一位有認證的生態導遊，隨他深入森林內的某個部落。部落的男子擅長爬樹獵食，女性則採摘天然草材做編織，生活縱原始，簡單的小食卻讓部落眾人感到快樂。芷珮打算留守森林三晚，故先預訂旅館，配套卻讓她大感滿足。她亦報名參與朱古力工作坊，親試可可果並一睹朱古力醬的製作過程。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

再創世紀#27粵
programme.desc: 端兒看到眾籌平台出事的新聞後，答應澤雨合作發展烹飪平台。程凱發現被定垚耍了，大興問罪，卻突然對她有了異樣感覺。力晨混入季生集團調查，高哲叮囑他小心。高哲意外收到思妤來電，思妤工作的環保公司面臨倒閉，請求高哲施援手。啟堂將智能家居引入傲堂旗下樓盤，取得巨大成功，定垚暗覺不安。其後啟堂欲收購程凱的超級電池發展電動車，程凱因決定追求定垚而有保留。澤雨首次在內地過生日，端兒炮製港式小吃慶祝，澤雨感動落淚。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血脂泛指膽固醇與三酸甘油酯，一旦出現異常，便可能誘發多種心臟疾病。內分泌及糖尿科醫生介紹新的血脂異常管理指引，並帶來改善建議。完成「通波仔」手術人士或擔心運動會加重心臟負擔，註冊物理治療師建議病友應循序漸進，讓心肺功能慢慢適應復康運動。治療師細說做運動時的安全指引與三不原則，若出現甚麼情況應立即停止？此外，嘉賓還即場引領主持做復康鍛練。「睇餸食飯」環節，廚藝專家傅季馨帶來「吉列魚柳伴他他汁」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 珠海某大學區隱藏滋味手工菜，筲箕海鮮配陳村粉、苦瓜撈起別具特色，「江南百花雞」更是經典名菜。凱晴、慧儀及後體驗騎馬樂，除了學騎術，不少得餵飼馬匹培養感情。深圳的大學區也有美食，吃過爆膏大頭蝦、鮮甜生蠔等火鍋料，再歎粥底精華。超市海鮮拼盤六十元人仔有找，還要無伏？香港都有性價比高的日式廚師發辦，十八道菜食材皆來自日本，人均僅約四百元！接着「味」遊泰國，品嚐由「摘星」名廚秘製食譜的招牌魷魚、船麵火鍋。

programme.title: 東坡家事#29粵
programme.desc: 季常和大妹請月娥回家，月娥拒絕。說書人將東坡詞構成東坡和琴操故事，皇上聽後懷恨，拒絕東坡請辭。東坡和少游、洪四到酒館飲酒解愁，東坡詩興大發，在酒桌寫上四句詩。東坡被捕下獄，皇上唸出東坡詩，罵他叛逆……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#167粵
programme.desc: 根發起男士暢飲聚會，但他發現人數愈來愈少。麗在代替喜分發花紅，但根卻發現自己的那份被麗以各種理由扣去，根怒極欲報仇，卻被亨發現。當晚，眾人更迫根負起責任，要他交伙食費及家用，根為此離家出走。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#12粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康和穆念慈為了賺取回家盤纏，在街頭賣藝，官差故意為難，楊康氣怒之下打傷他們；郭靖到桃花島找黃蓉時遇上周伯通，周伯通想讓郭靖陪他拆招解悶；眼見郭靖執意尋找黃蓉，周伯通建議郭靖找師父洪七公來給自己撐腰。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 今集邀得梁漢文、方力申兩位帥哥，Do姐顯得心花怒放，並大談歐、美、日乘計程車的「畀貼士」文化。台灣「問題專員」走進樓上舖，享受「電鑽男」既刺激又舒暢的服務，到底「搞邊科」？緊接「試食題」，名廚即場以小牛的某部位烹調美食，梁漢文「瞓身」使用雙重錦囊，看來對答中食材胸有成竹！K小姐介紹韓國百貨店中一件男女老幼皆適用的產品，是甚麼東西？踏入積分兌換貨幣環節，有嘉賓不聽隊友意見，結果看着對手「執到寶」！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫絞盡腦汁，以一段中西愛情故事介紹張曦雯、蔡思貝、陳嘉寶和賴慰玲四位美女嘉賓，Do姐尚算滿意。K小姐試坐韓國飛碟形觀光塔，「升空」時還獲派神秘黃色物件，有何用途？泰國一間特色餐廳可品嚐各款「加料」營養美食，究竟是甚麼主題食肆？台灣一輛「好玩的士」不但提供「看戲」、「唱K」服務，只要客人做到某件事，更不收車資！兩隊組員在兌換貨幣環節「心水」不一，要藉「包剪揼」決定地方，最終可會得到幸運之神眷顧？

programme.desc: 亨為激發根重新做人，將他心愛的長洲大包掉進海中，蘇根竟跟著跳海，根被救回後變得痴痴呆呆。當晚根看到眾人對他的鼓勵行動，深受感動之際，突聽到母親在後樓梯的慘叫，根衝出時卻看到三正拋掉自己所有的玩具。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖替被蛇咬傷的周伯通吸毒，周伯通堅持與他結拜。周伯通發現郭靖竟有《九陰真經》下卷，便騙他學了起來。歐陽鋒替歐陽克來桃花島提親，黃蓉想跟郭靖離島，被歐陽克糾纏，洪七公踏浪而來，也替郭靖來求親。

食平3D粵
programme.desc: Super Girls跟肥媽學煮四餸一湯。 俗語有云「一鴣頂九雞」，用鷓鴣煲湯的營養功效妙不可言。羊腩煮法千變萬化，肥媽以紅棗紅麴燜羊腩。還有「甜辣蟹」、「糖醋蝦」，以及令嘉賓們喜出望外的炒飯。

programme.desc: 烹調講究火候，深圳一間日式爐端燒超惹味，晚上八時還有火焰騷觀賞！珠海有家主打醉鵝的老字號食肆，設專人在顧客面前燜煮鵝肉，品嚐濃味過後更可打邊爐。食完可再往隱世甜品店，試盡各式創意甜品，還可看着店內的香港電影海報，掃吃腸粉、魚皮等港式小食。本港美食優惠，尖沙咀有餐廳提供亞洲風味的十二道融合美饌，用味蕾嚐遍全亞洲。主持們另到會展享用車胎人推介餐廳的粵菜午餐，多款經典點心做頭盤外，主菜龍蝦都有三款吃法。

programme.desc: 小丸子打算儲錢，但每次一收到零用錢便馬上花光，於是想到一個辦法，便是把錢藏起來再把事情忘記。爺爺想到自己老是寵愛小丸子一個，冷落了姐姐，於是千方百計去寵愛姐姐，卻落得兩面不是人。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集「開心SHARE」的主題是課堂活動，小朋友投稿訴說相關趣事。在英文課堂中扮演餐廳食客和服務員，使人份外投入。體育課吸引好動的朋友，更有運動健將分享得獎喜悅。視藝課給予學生做手工機會，玲玲姐姐藉相片展示昔日「大作」！若問起子健哥哥最喜愛的課堂活動，他可能會答繪畫。貓頭鷹是夜行動物，想於日間「見到」牠，或要靠畫作實現。貓頭鷹的身體和腳部有甚麼細節？還要畫上樹枝和樹葉，為其「打造」棲息環境。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 縱使戰勝了赤之女王，冀盼的和平卻沒有到來，邪音魔仍舊侵擾愛麗絲比亞，企圖奪取女生的音樂之力。在一次戰鬥中，一名來歷不明的神秘劍客，更在阿源等人面前出現，她的名字是花騎士・真誠。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#10粵
programme.desc: 楊帆識破碧池等人安排希靈出任其秘書的用意，卻毫不在意，一心只想物色能為他帶來龐大利益的得力助手，並視范特栖為最佳人選。他利誘范特栖加盟跨世代，卻遭對方拒絕。范特栖親近張太原來另有目的，為達到目標付出不少努力，詎料……楊帆在范特栖最落魄之時出手相助，范特栖認為楊帆只想利用他的外表優勢謀取利益，楊帆設法說服他，成功將其羅致旗下。另一方面，希靈正式上班，文謙、碧池等人驚覺她的工作崗位竟有變動……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#15粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如恍然雪文一直處心積慮要搶走她的一切。雪文為報復繼威，向家謙告發他與其昌收受回佣……幸如再次胃痛入院，擔心會像夢境般患癌。浩恩打算放棄追求幸如，熙妍卻鼓勵他堅持。幸如得悉雪文一事，希望藉此撮合她跟繼威結婚。家謙、啟榮就其昌的去留爭論，兄弟鬥爭升溫。QMC的客戶突然接連解約，家謙面臨業績壓力。佩貞得知雪文之事，催促繼威討回雪文的歡心。幸如使計令繼威的錢債壓力加劇，又故意刺激雪文，以加速二人結婚。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#20粵普
programme.desc: 梅雨天影響浦榮生意，紀封辦北非觀雨團應對，蜜語洞察高考生家庭的商機，會議上爭取通過高考房促銷方案；翱翔從思源處得到方案，想同樣在寬利推行，高價找芷純談合作；予誠確診胃癌，貞貞為手術之事與聶母爭吵後見紅

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 沿亞馬遜河域發掘更多體驗，芷珮甫抵達小社區已獲野生猴子「歡迎」，再經水路深入動物救援中心，探探被遺棄、受保護的動物。探索原住民部落的風土人情，芷珮入鄉隨俗畫臉部彩繪，一嚐正宗奇恰酒與風味午餐，還獲族人指導傳統吹箭技巧。體會叢林活力後要鬆一鬆，浸住高海拔天然溫泉，細賞安第斯山脈景，超梳乎！回市中心路上，遇主打傳統料理Fritada的餐廳，當然不可錯過。朱古力亦是厄瓜多爾名物，往咖啡店品嚐冷、熱滋味。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 樓盤新視野 之港島東太古式生活粵
再創世紀#28粵PG
programme.desc: 定垚不明白啟堂為何急於收購超級電池，直至知道天生對電池也有興趣。程凱設計Q版程式向定垚示愛，堅持只要自己還喜歡她，就不會答應合作。高哲挽救了思妤的綠色產業，思妤萌生與他復合想法。澤雨隨安東、日朗推廣端兒的烹飪平台，意外發現二人只是騙子；澤雨、端兒為夢想破滅而失落。程凱決定和天生簽約，啟堂的反應平常令定垚起疑。定垚終發現啟堂的計劃，打算犧牲程凱拖垮天生。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 烹調講究火候，深圳一間日式爐端燒超惹味，晚上八時還有火焰騷觀賞！珠海有家主打醉鵝的老字號食肆，設專人在顧客面前燜煮鵝肉，品嚐濃味過後更可打邊爐。食完可再往隱世甜品店，試盡各式創意甜品，還可看着店內的香港電影海報，掃吃腸粉、魚皮等港式小食。本港美食優惠，尖沙咀有餐廳提供亞洲風味的十二道融合美饌，用味蕾嚐遍全亞洲。主持們另到會展享用車胎人推介餐廳的粵菜午餐，多款經典點心做頭盤外，主菜龍蝦都有三款吃法。

programme.title: 東坡家事#30粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)少游自首，皇上稱已知一切；原來閏之告密認為東坡不忠不義，恨不得煎東坡皮，食東坡肉；被判烹刑的東坡告知閏之可另找歸宿。皇上微服出巡，聽到不同百姓為東坡事件爭拗。新任御膳房總管帶來多盅「東坡肉」上殿……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#168粵
programme.desc: 亨為激發根重新做人，將他心愛的長洲大包掉進海中，蘇根竟跟著跳海，根被救回後變得痴痴呆呆。當晚根看到眾人對他的鼓勵行動，深受感動之際，突聽到母親在後樓梯的慘叫，根衝出時卻看到三正拋掉自己所有的玩具。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖替被蛇咬傷的周伯通吸毒，周伯通堅持與他結拜。周伯通發現郭靖竟有《九陰真經》下卷，便騙他學了起來。歐陽鋒替歐陽克來桃花島提親，黃蓉想跟郭靖離島，被歐陽克糾纏，洪七公踏浪而來，也替郭靖來求親。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 一顆擋不住的野心，讓慈禧開展長達四十七年的垂簾聽政，到底慈禧太后是如何誕生？她的同治中興、洋務運動，是否功不補過？成為皇帝的奶媽，榮華富貴享之不盡！中原賤人館的羅拔和陳仔公開皇室御用奶媽的甄選條件。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 本集講述慈禧太后的「衣食住行」至TOP指南，並有王晶、陶傑評老佛爺的理財之道。日本宅男喜歡到女僕咖啡屋做主人，清朝光緒年間的上海亦有「書寓」，代表最高級的妓院，有清裝美女陪你彈古箏、唸詩、彈琵琶。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 青春時代

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran S03 - It's Time To Open a Shop
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit Jared's shop, which really does stock everything, and everything has a place. When they get home, JoJo decides to open her own shop with her till and panda pounds. Having found lots of things that they can sell, JoJo is disappointed when she can't quickly find what her customers want to buy. Gran Gran has a plan, and soon everything has a place - perfect for JoJo and Gran Gran's customers Jared and Cynthia to find just what they want to buy.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Getting Ready Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are getting ready for the same woodland adventure, but their mornings all look slightly different.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitch's campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Cucumber
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Cucumber performing Cool Under Pressure while trying to not let any obstacle ruin her calm routine.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
programme.desc: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realise she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Where? There!
programme.desc: Laa‐Laa and Po play a game of 'hide and seek'. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dispsy are hiding too and Laa‐Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Book
programme.desc: In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say book and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different books and explore how they look and feel. We see a flip book, a flap book and Dee helps make a scrapbook. We see a gold book, a fluffy book and even meet a child dressed as a book! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Snowflakes
programme.desc: It's summer in OKIDO, but Messy wants to chill out in the snow, so he's lucky when the snowflakes come out to play!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ready Sheddy Go
programme.desc: Nori and Dot are stuck in a treehouse without a door. How can Mojo and Bo get them out? By sending the treehouse flying across town, that's how!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - White Cliffs of Dover, England
programme.desc: Glitch tries to teach the Grimbots by drawing on a chalkboard. Before he can finish, his last piece of chalk snaps and the grumpy Grandmaster demands the Grimbots find a fresh supply. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the White Cliffs of Dover in England, to cheer Kyan as he finishes a cross-channel swim, but a large cloud of dust blocks his way to the shore. On the beach, Lars and Foz find the Grimbots mining the cliffs with a big drill, causing a big crack to spread across the rock face. Can

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Creek
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Circus
programme.desc: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hungry Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Andy and Jen are throwing themselves a party to celebrate an epic year on Dino Island but discover that their prehistoric pals have been helping themselves to all the party food.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Roly's First Day
programme.desc: As Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.desc: The grimbots attach a bit of the Taj Mahal to GrimHQ. It remains to be seen whether the Go Jetters can fix the glitch.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Ahoy Captain Pak Choi

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. But Glitch doesn't realise how dangerous his cold germs can be, so the Go Jetters will have to stop him from making a baby gorilla sick - all while trying to keep it safe from dangerous traps left by hunters.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jetter or No Jetter?
programme.desc: Foz starts to think his team doesn't need him anymore. Can Tala convince him he still has what it takes to be a Go Jetter, or will he follow Glitch down a different path?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Turbo Ted
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ready Sheddy Go
programme.desc: Nori and Dot are stuck in a treehouse without a door. How can Mojo and Bo get them out? By sending the treehouse flying across town, that's how!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Freezy Sprinklers
programme.desc: Evil Pea plots to take over the whole supermarket by making fake freezy sprinklers to fool Supertato. But what is her real plan, and will Supertato stop her?

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Young Veggies: Part 2
programme.desc: Supertato reveals how he learned to control his potato powers, defeat Evil Pea and save the supermarket for the very first time.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veg-O-Vision Song Contest Song
programme.desc: It's Veg-O-Vision time and Rylan Clark has some amazing fruit and veggie songs for you!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veggie Birthday Song
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team have a veggie birthday song for you. Sing and dance along!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - How to be a Nitwit Superhero Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is tired of everyone always cheering for Supertato. In this song she looks at all the things that make Supertato super, but realises that she loves being evil!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Brave Banana Badge
programme.desc: A big dark cloud hovers over the clubhouse and a storm begins. It turns out the squirrels are scared of lightning! Fortunately, Duggee has his Brave Banana Badge, so he knows exactly how to help them overcome their fears.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Water Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels learn all about where water comes from, and their journey takes them from the sea and back to the kitchen sink and another drink of water. Wow! Water is amazing!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Hairdressers
programme.desc: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Stumpfest
programme.desc: Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Favourite Thing
programme.desc: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Hippos
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to explore the Okavango Delta in Botswana, Africa, in search of hippos. Along the way, Andy meets a giraffe, hitches a ride with an oxpecker and gets stuck in the mud with fighting hippos.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Piraputanga
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Bonito in the Amazon rainforest on a global adventure to witness piraputanga, a species of fish, leaping from the water to feed on wild berries in the trees above. Along the way, they meet a troop of brown capuchins.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the “Full Moon Scimitar”, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...
